target: barrier: reach +5R before -1R within 72h (stop = 1.0 ATR, conservative intra-bar convention)
description: Excursion/barrier model v1. MEASURED, not extrapolated: base rates sit ~10pp BELOW the driftless random-walk benchmark 1/(1+R) at every R because a 72h horizon truncates. Level is predicted at 5R per side; other R values scale the measured base curve. Cross-sectional AUC ~0.62 is genuine asset selection (market-wide features alone score exactly 0.5000 within a timestamp). Tradeable within-timestamp spread is +0.109R gross, median 0.000R, positive in only 34% of timestamps -- thin and outlier-driven. Profitability is REGIME-DEPENDENT: 1 of 5 rising-market periods profitable, corr(EV, BTC return) = -0.509. See docs/research/excursion-model.md.
